output a list of breakpoints via function

The line and setline messages to zigzag~ allows you to define a ramp with breakpoints in line~ format (as output by the function object). The line message will output the ramp immediately, whereas the setline message will cause zigzag~ to store the ramp until it received a bang in the left inlet.
